label: Named author at GeoCart 2024
basis: GeoCart 2024 session 2 programme, New Zealand Cartographic Society lists Daniel Exeter as an author of “Revealing uncertainty through the visualisation of geographically and thematically classified map collections”. GeoCart 2024 session 3 programme, New Zealand Cartographic Society lists Daniel Exeter as an author of “Automating advocacy: developing a geospatial tool for creating local alcohol harm risk profiles”.
